Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.ui.admin

Class BarChartView

View
com.example.cosmos_discovery.ui.admin.BarChartView
public class BarChartView extends View
Simple vertical bar chart for the admin dashboard. Draws white semi-transparent bars on whatever background the parent provides. Call setEntries(List) to supply data; the view re-draws itself.
